# TabWeaver - Cross-Tab AI Browser Automation Extension

> TabWeaver is an open-source, client-side Manifest V3 Chrome extension that bridges web AI chat interfaces (ChatGPT, Claude, DeepSeek, Gemini, Kimi, etc.) to any other active browser tab using simple `#` or `@` mentions. It requires zero API keys, zero Python/Node servers, and operates with strict local privacy.

## Core Capabilities
- **Cross-Tab Control via Natural Language**: Mention any open tab directly in web AI chat input fields (`#wikipedia`, `@github`).
- **Zero API Key Requirement**: Leverages the user's existing logged-in web AI chat session without paying per-token API charges.
- **Client-Side Token-Efficient DOM Distiller**: Distills target page DOM into lightweight, accessible semantic trees without wasting context tokens.
- **Bi-Directional Action Loop**: AI outputs structured JSON actions (click, type, scroll, select); TabWeaver executes them natively in the target tab and streams live progress and summaries back.
- **Visual Status Feedback**: Target tabs display a Cyber Breathing Halo to indicate connection; a draggable Floating Capsule renders execution logs in real time.
- **Universal Multi-Platform Support**: Works out of the box with 18+ major AI chat interfaces.

## Comparison with Cloud-based Browser Agents
- **Cloud/API Agents (Operator, Computer Use APIs)**: Require $20+/month API subscriptions, remote cloud server instances, high latency, and sending sensitive session cookies to third-party clouds.
- **TabWeaver**: 100% local Chrome sandbox execution, free and open-source (MIT), zero telemetry, zero data collected.
